status.desc: Statuses: auto view, emoji, reply, forward
status.usage:
*Statuses*
› Auto view: *{0}*
› Emoji: *{1}*
› Reply: *{2}*
› Sent to: *{3}*

*Examples:*
› status on — view and receive every status
› status off
› status no-dl — view only, without receiving them
› status hide-view — view without the "seen" receipt
› status &delay — wait a little before viewing
› status only-view 2250700000000,2250700000001
› status except-view 2250700000000
› status emoji 🔥,❤️ · status emoji off
› status msg Nice status! · status msg off
› status forward 2250700000000 · status forward me

_Options combine: status no-dl &delay_

› antidelete g — in the same chat
› antidelete 2250700000000 — to that number
› antidelete off
